name: OS File Organizer & Inspector
description: Scans directories, detects duplicate files, and safely organizes files by category without overwriting existing data.

tools.name: scan_directory
tools.description: Summarize file counts, sizes, and categories inside a directory.

tools.name: find_duplicates
tools.description: Find exact duplicate files by size and SHA-256 hash.

tools.name: organize_directory
tools.description: Plan or apply categorization of top-level files into Documents, Images, Videos, Audio, Archives, Code, and Other.

apply.description: Set true to execute moves; false returns a dry-run plan.
